sources.quote: Two US senators say the Trump administration is breaking the law by withholding the FISA court decision while it presses Congress to renew America's most sweeping surveillance program.
Senators say officials hid a ruling on warrantless searches past its release deadline.

claims.statement: Two US senators say the government is withholding a FISA court ruling past its release deadline.

sources.quote: US officials want Section 702 renewed before damaging court ruling goes public

claims.statement: Officials reportedly want Section 702 renewed before the damaging ruling becomes public.

sources.quote: the Trump administration is breaking the law by withholding the FISA court decision

claims.statement: Wired frames the withholding as the administration breaking the law.

analysis.headline: Senators say US hid FISA court ruling ahead of surveillance renewal push
analysis.summary: Two US senators say officials withheld a FISA court ruling on warrantless searches past its legal release deadline, allegedly to secure Section 702's renewal before the damaging decision becomes public.
